title: Gravity generator

hazard.text: Field surge: everyone near floats for 2 s

steps.text: Lay the field on the ghost
Drag the field to turn it
Hold it green; the ring fills

guide.mistake: Far off the ghost: a field surge, everyone floats 2 s

knobs._hold_note: hold_s replaces the mockup's hold sized from the step's share at the officer's rate (design 6d), retired by design 1a: the values are the mockup's for a damaged job (share 13.9 s; 0.62 of it, held to 5-9.5 s, for one ripple, 0.5 of it for two from level 3; plus 0.4 s a level).

_min_round_note: Provisional (design 8): 40% of the scripted hand's fastest round at each level, over every state and four seeds, until people's play is measured.
